note: Kentucky State Parks campground near Cadiz, one wooded loop on a bluff above Lake Barkley. Sites on the north side of the loop see the lake through the trees; a short trail leads to the park beach, and the campground has its own boat ramp. --Claude
summary: Kept. 79 paved back-in sites (73 electric 30A + water, 6 walk-up no-electric); $28 Sun-Thu / $30 Fri-Sat / $34 holiday; two bathhouses, laundry, dump. Season 04-01..10-31 (RA). WATERFRONT DOWN lakefront -> lakeview: the old evidence measured the beach parking lot, not the campground. PIN MOVE ~630 m. Website fix; policy copies cleared.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWN: lakefront -> lakeview. The stored evidence ('parallel camp rows on open grass ~30-60m from summer-pool shoreline (drawn-down beach in between)') describes the beach parking lot at the stored pin, not the campground: parks.ky.gov says the camper trail 'ends at the back of the beach parking lot', 0.3 mile from the Campground Pavilion. The real loop is under full canopy ~630 m ESE (leaf-off KyFromAbove imagery). Nearest RV sites are on the north row (sites 37-50, around 36.8551,-87.9150 for 043), on a forested bluff ~25-35 m above the lake: 3DEP has the north-row road at 144.2 m (36.855458,-87.916004) and 137.6 m (36.854799,-87.914507), with the 109.4 m summer pool reached only at ~70-75 m down a steep wooded slope. Every RA site is 'Near Water - no'. The RA photos (2008) of 043 and 037 show the lake through the trees, so a filtered lakeview holds. These sites are sold nightly on RA. Replacement evidence: 'leaf-off KyFromAbove at 36.8550,-87.9167: wooded loop on a bluff; north-row sites (037-050, 043 at ~36.8551,-87.9150) 25-35 m above and ~70-75 m from the 359-ft summer pool through forest (3DEP); RA photos of 037/043 show the lake through the trees; earlier lakefront evidence was the beach parking lot at 36.8568,-87.9234'.

PIN MOVE (over 250 m): stored 36.8568,-87.9234 is on the beach parking lot. Target 36.8550,-87.9167 (centre of the campground loop, leaf-off imagery). Distance ~630 m. The old evidence's 'old pin in forest ~600m E of campground' was the correct campground area; a previous edit moved the pin the wrong way.
HOOKUPS: electric 30 and water confirmed; sewer false added.

SITES: count 78 -> 79 (RA 73 electric + 6 no-electric; parks.ky.gov says '78 sites'). max_rig_ft 71 (030) and pull_through false added (every site Back-In). Six pads are 'Driveway Grade: Severe' on RA.

FEES: 20/30 -> 28/34 (electric $28 / $30 / $34 holiday). The no-electric sites are walk-up only with no posted price, so the old $20 low no longer applies. Policy copies (reservation_fee 6, extra_person) cleared to the state:KY row.
SEASON: 04-01..10-31 confirmed from the RA calendar; the 'Approximate' note is cleared.
